show.description: In a world where passion, rivalry, and hidden identities collide, Naina, a kind-hearted yet fiery dancer, finds herself constantly at odds with the arrogant Aryan. Their clashes turn into sparks on and off the stage, even as her best friend Reema flirts her way toward Rohit. But when a mysterious masked benefactor named Raj begins secretly helping those in need, Naina’s heart is torn between admiration and suspicion. Watch Now!
